chunks: "It is announced at al-Ḥijr: Lo, whoever has had his provisions cut off, let him come forward, and it shall be given to him."

key_terms.الْحِجْرِ: al-Ḥijr, the known place near the Kaʿbah where the announcement is made
key_terms.انْقَطَعَتْ: has been cut off or exhausted
key_terms.فَلْيَحْضُرْ: let him come forward or present himself
key_terms.فَيُدْفَعَ: then it is handed over or given
key_terms.يُنَادَى: it is publicly announced or called out

ai.seo_question: What happens in hajj if a pilgrim runs out of provisions?
ai.summary: This report describes a public announcement at al-Ḥijr for anyone whose travel provisions have run out to come forward and receive support. It highlights the communal care associated with hajj and the practical provision made for pilgrims in need.
